reports.title: Q2 Holdings, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results;

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Q2 Holdings is providing guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 as follows:
•Total revenue of $226.0 million to $230.0 million, which would represent year-over-year growth of 9 to 10 percent.
•Adjusted EBITDA of $62.4 million to $65.4 million, representing 28 percent of revenue for the quarter.
Q2 Holdings is providing updated guidance for the full-year 2026 as follows:
•Total revenue of $888.0 million to $892.0 million, which would represent year-over-year growth of 12 percent.
•Adjusted EBITDA of $253.0 million to $256.0 million, representing 28 to 29 percent to of revenue for the year.
